title: In Our City, The Number Above Your Head Is How Many People You've Killed
description: Everyone in Zero City is a 0. We're proud of it. Except Mr. Gray never takes off his hat. Then the wind took it… 😳

question.text: Do I put on the hat?

scenes.narration: In my city, the number above your head shows how many people you have killed. Everyone is a *zero*. Except one man.
We're so proud of it, we built a giant golden zero in the middle of the city. Zero City. The safest city on Earth.
People don't say hello here. They point at the zero above their head, and smile.
Except Mr. Gray. He never takes off his hat. Not in summer. Not indoors. Not even at *funerals*.
My friends said his number was a hundred. My mom just said: don't look at him.
Then one Tuesday, a storm hit the city.
And the wind took his hat. His number was three hundred and *twelve*.
The whole city screamed. People ran. Mothers covered their kids' eyes.
By night, everyone surrounded him. Right in front of the giant zero.
You want to know who they were? Three hundred and twelve people who were about to kill one of *you*.
scenes.speaker: gray

scenes.narration: Every zero in this city is because of him. He took the numbers, so we never had to.
The next morning, Mr. Gray was gone. Nobody knows where.
But his hat was lying on my doorstep. With a note: *your turn*. Do I put it on? Tell me.
